historical_commentary.text: As with its companion Part I note, this introductory piece is tied to 4D View, a companion product that has since been discontinued and whose functionality has been superseded by newer form objects and web-based grids in current 4D applications, making the specific technique obsolete for new development.
related_updates: 4D View has been discontinued as a standalone product/plug-in in current 4D
List box form objects and web-based grid components now serve the role 4D View areas served in 2003
